query: On 0.13.0 with mixed WAN/FLUX/Qwen production workloads on one GPU, Qwen Image Edit graphs randomly output black images after long runs; disappears after worker restart, suggesting runtime state/cache contamination rather than graph config.

desired.outcome: Maintainer response: Comfy 0.13 is old, numerous bugfixes since; resolution = upgrade ComfyUI. Not deeply confirmed but issue closed.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; proposed fix is actionable and directionally correct.
